text:
ajones: Quick check — are we all aligned on the v0.14.2 bump across API, runtime, console, and SDKs? Cutoff is EOD PDT tomorrow.

emily_dev: I'm green on API PRs, one more docs tweak for changelog. I'll push the changelog entry today. :white_check_mark:

ryan-sre: Runtime has a small ABI change for KV cache handling; PR is open (WIP). Need one more ok from @sam_platform before we flip the build matrix.

sam_platform: Looking now. If tests pass in the next run I can approve. ETA 2 hours.

priya_product: Heads-up — console expects the API minor bump. Can we avoid a breaking change in the SDKs? Product wants a fast rollback plan if console trips.

emily_dev: No breaking changes in API surface for this patch. SDKs only need a version bump + changelog line about performance fix.

ajones: Good. Two coordination items: 1) Ensure changelogs updated in each repo. 2) Tagging/branch policy — we need tags pushed before the cutoff and the release note draft in the release repo.

ryan-sre: For runtime, I've added a draft changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md. Will request final review after CI. Also adding the tag command here for reference:

```
# runtime repo
git checkout release/v0.14
git merge --no-ff my/kv-cache-fix
git tag -a v0.14.2 -m "v0.14.2 runtime: kv cache stability"
git push origin v0.14.2
```

sam_platform: That looks fine. One nit: please include the short SHA in the tag message for traceability.

priya_product: For console, I've queued a canary deploy to staging once tags are in. If console accepts the minor, we promote. If it fails, we fallback to v0.14.1. Need a runbook entry for rollback — @ryan-sre can you add the quick rollback steps to the runbook?

ryan-sre: Yup — adding a minimal rollback of runtime nodes (drain + revert to v0.14.1 image) and API routing fallback (route traffic to dedicated older cluster). Will post steps in the incident-runbook doc.

emily_dev: SDKs: I'll cut 3 language SDKs after tags are live. Example bump command for npm package:

```
# in sdk-js
npm version patch --no-git-tag-version
# update package.json changelog
git add package.json CHANGELOG.md
git commit -m "chore(sdk): bump to v0.14.2"
git tag v0.14.2
git push && git push --tags
```

ajones: Perfect. Two last checks: (A) Does anyone need a snapshot of compat matrix updated? (B) Who's on post-cutoff watch?

sam_platform: I'll update the compat matrix (docs/compat.md) in a single PR that points to each repo's tag. Will file it now.

priya_product: I'll take post-cutoff watch for console for the first 60 minutes. @ajones can you cover API?

ajones: Yep I'll watch API metrics and alerts for 30m after rollout. @deploy-bot please schedule the coordinated rollout to start at 10:00 PDT tomorrow if all tags present.

deploy-bot: scheduled coordinated rollout for 2024-06-18 10:00 PDT (UTC 2024-06-18T17:00:00Z). Notified: ajones, emily_dev, ryan-sre, sam_platform, priya_product.

ryan-sre: Quick blocker note — the runtime PR depends on a small infra change in eng-infra that hasn't merged. If it doesn't land we'll hold runtime and roll API/SDKs/console with the previous runtime image.

emily_dev: Noted. If runtime is held, I'll coordinate a patch release that keeps API behavior identical.

ajones: OK flagged. Action items: emily -> push API changelog + tag; sam -> approve runtime CI; ryan -> finish infra dependency or call hold; emily/sam -> cut SDK tags; priya -> prepare console canary and rollback doc; sam -> update compat matrix. We'll reconvene async here for final go/no-go at T-1h (9:00 PDT).

priya_product: Updated the console runbook with rollback steps and a short checklist. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/console-rollout (internal).

ajones: Thanks everyone. Ping here if anything slips. :rocket:
